name: Review the specs
description: Loops over SPECS.md: re-reads it against the intent, the research and any spike and prototype findings, works out what is still missing or ambiguous, asks you, and rewrites it, until nothing is left to ask (it ends the document with <!-- specs: complete -->) or five passes. Waits for your approval only on the last pass.

parameters.label: What kind of work this is
parameters.description: How the prompts name the work, e.g. "feature" or "bug fix".

parameters.label: Anything else to settle
parameters.description: Extra instructions, e.g. what to fold in on the first pass.

parameters.label: The line that ends the loop
